description.value:
This electronic "guard dog" resembles a squat black box the size of a toaster with a screen. Upgraded versions use holograms to resemble guard dogs, although many are customized to resemble more exotic pets, ranging from hell hounds to baby wyverns. Assigning authorized users and establishing an electronic guard dog's territory takes 10 minutes.

This projects a holographic depiction of a Medium-sized creature to scare intruders. The item's sensors are just responsive enough for it to calculate how to lunge at intruders without getting close enough to make contact. It has the following statistics: +21 Intimidation (on a critical success to [[/act demoralize]], the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fleeing] for 1 round); +18 Perception.

Activate—Dogged Deterrence r (auditory)

Trigger The guard dog detects an unauthorized creature within its designated territory

Effect The electronic guard dog attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] one unauthorized creature within 30 feet, using 5 charges of the electronic guard dog's battery.
